description: 按事前登记实际原分页函数取得66目录，保存全部真实定位，不读取股票收益或重试
executed_source:
import json,hashlib,re,time,unicodedata,threading
from pathlib import Path
from datetime import datetime
from zoneinfo import ZoneInfo
from concurrent.futures import ThreadPoolExecutor,as_completed
from urllib.parse import urljoin
import requests
from bs4 import BeautifulSoup

base=Path('reports/research/510300_industrial_cash_constraint_original_panel_v1')
proto=json.loads((base/'protocol.json').read_text(encoding='utf-8-sig'))
old=Path('reports/research/510300_industrial_multidimensional_cash_constraint_source_v1')
root=old/'sources'/'catalog_latest_release.html'
assert hashlib.sha256(root.read_bytes()).hexdigest()==proto['source_route']['actual_root_sha256']
assert not (base/'实际66目录GET账本.jsonl').exists(),'已有实际调用账本，禁止重复发出请求'
sources=base/'sources'
sources.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
tz=ZoneInfo('Asia/Shanghai')
def now(): return datetime.now(tz).isoformat()
lock=threading.Lock()
ledger=base/'实际66目录GET账本.jsonl'
def trace(r):
    with lock:
        with ledger.open('a',encoding='utf-8') as f:
            f.write(json.dumps(r,ensure_ascii=False)+'\n'); f.flush()
def write_json(name,data):
    (base/name).write_text(json.dumps(data,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2),encoding='utf-8')
def fetch(page):
    url=f'https://www.stats.gov.cn/sj/zxfb/index_{page}.html'
    item={'page_index':page,'requested_url':url,'started_at':now(),'attempt':1,'raw_GET_retries':0}
    trace({'event':'REQUEST_STARTED',**item})
    try:
        r=requests.get(url,timeout=(10,30))
        p=sources/f'catalog_index_{page}.html'
        p.write_bytes(r.content)
        item.update(status_code=r.status_code,final_url=r.url,path=p.as_posix(),bytes=len(r.content),sha256=hashlib.sha256(r.content).hexdigest(),completed_at=now())
        item['status']='OK' if r.status_code==200 else 'HTTP_NOT_OK'
    except Exception as e:
        item.update(status='GET_FAILED_NO_RETRY',error_type=type(e).__name__,error=str(e),completed_at=now())
    trace({'event':'REQUEST_FINISHED',**item})
    return item
receipts=[]
with ThreadPoolExecutor(max_workers=6) as pool:
    jobs={pool.submit(fetch,k):k for k in range(1,67)}
    for future in as_completed(jobs):
        receipts.append(future.result())
        n=len(receipts)
        if n%8==0 or n==66:
            print(f'原发布目录已读 {n}/66；成功 {sum(x["status"]=="OK" for x in receipts)}；禁止重试',flush=True)
receipts.sort(key=lambda x:x['page_index'])
write_json('全部66原发布目录实际取得回执.json',receipts)
pages=[{'page_index':0,'requested_url':'https://www.stats.gov.cn/sj/zxfb/','status':'OK','path':root.as_posix(),'sha256':proto['source_route']['actual_root_sha256'],'cached_reuse':True}]+receipts
records={}
excluded=[]
targets=set(proto['target_economic_periods'])
for page in pages:
    if page['status']!='OK': continue
    soup=BeautifulSoup(Path(page['path']).read_bytes().decode('utf-8-sig',errors='replace'),'html.parser')
    for a in soup.select('a[href]'):
        title=a.get('title') or a.get_text(' ',strip=True)
        title=unicodedata.normalize('NFKC',title)
        title=re.sub(r'\s+','',title)
        if '规模以上工业企业' not in title or '利润' not in title: continue
        match=re.match(r'^(20\d{2})年',title)
        if not match or any(x in title for x in ['解读','统计师','工业司']): 
            excluded.append({'page':page['page_index'],'title':title,'href':a.get('href')});continue
        year=int(match.group(1))
        tail=title[match.end():]
        mm=re.match(r'1[—－\-–至~～一]+(1[0-2]|[2-9])月(?:份)?',tail)
        if mm: month=int(mm.group(1))
        elif re.match(r'(?:全国)?规模以上工业企业',tail) or tail.startswith('全年'): month=12
        else:
            excluded.append({'page':page['page_index'],'title':title,'href':a.get('href'),'reason':'原标题累计月数未明确'});continue
        period=f'{year}M{month:02d}'
        if period not in targets: continue
        url=urljoin(page['requested_url'],a['href'])
        if not re.search(r'/t\d{8}_\d+\.html$',url): continue
        key=(period,url)
        li=a.find_parent('li')
        li_text=li.get_text(' ',strip=True) if li else a.parent.get_text(' ',strip=True)
        date_match=re.findall(r'20\d{2}[-/\.]\d{2}[-/\.]\d{2}',li_text)
        origin={'catalog_page_index':page['page_index'],'catalog_path':page['path'],'catalog_sha256':page['sha256'],'raw_href':a['href'],'raw_title':title,'catalog_original_display_dates':list(dict.fromkeys(date_match)),'original_li_text':li_text[:1800]}
        if key not in records: records[key]={'economic_period':period,'url':url,'original_title':title,'catalog_origins':[]}
        if origin not in records[key]['catalog_origins']: records[key]['catalog_origins'].append(origin)
mapping=[]
for period in proto['target_economic_periods']:
    found=[v for (p,u),v in records.items() if p==period]
    mapping.append({'economic_period':period,'locator_status':'EXACTLY_ONE_ORIGINAL' if len(found)==1 else ('MISSING_ORIGINAL' if not found else 'MULTIPLE_ORIGINALS_UNRESOLVED'),'candidate_count':len(found),'candidates':found})
summary={'study_id':proto['study_id'],'registered_at':proto['registered_at'],'completed_at':now(),'new_catalog_GETs':len(receipts),'successful_catalog_GETs':sum(x['status']=='OK' for x in receipts),'failed_catalog_GETs':[x for x in receipts if x['status']!='OK'],'root_cached_reuse':True,'target_period_count':len(mapping),'exactly_one_count':sum(x['locator_status']=='EXACTLY_ONE_ORIGINAL' for x in mapping),'missing_or_duplicate':[x for x in mapping if x['locator_status']!='EXACTLY_ONE_ORIGINAL'],'report_GETs':0,'new_model_fits':0,'new_linear_regressions':0,'new_simple_weighted_scores':0,'new_stock_labels':0,'new_accounts':0,'source_code_edits':0,'financial_status':'NOT_REGISTERED_NOT_RUN'}
write_json('全部79经济期_真实目录定位登记.json',mapping)
write_json('实际目录中未纳入原利润发布的标题.json',excluded)
write_json('目录定位结果_未取得79原报告.json',summary)
print(json.dumps({k:v for k,v in summary.items() if k not in ['failed_catalog_GETs','missing_or_duplicate']},ensure_ascii=False,indent=2),flush=True)
print('缺项或重项',json.dumps(summary['missing_or_duplicate'],ensure_ascii=False)[:5000],flush=True)
